items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: And he was so encouraging. He knew I had a passion for it and he encouraged it

ctx.x: Mr. DeVoe. And he was so encouraging. He knew I had a passion for it and he encouraged it, you know, and he’d give me the — he’d sign a pass for me saying, and I actually did play on the Senior Revue, I did two songs which was total head-scratching to the audience. Not only did I not know what I was doing, they certainly didn’t know what I was doing. And that was my first public performance you know.
